mainEntity.name: What do I need to start with a new sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: At minimum: a bucket and ladle for making steam, a thermometer and a sand timer. Our Starter package covers the bucket, ladle and thermometer and adds eucalyptus essence. The Deluxe and Supreme packages add a sand timer and backrests. Every package is 10% off the individual prices.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver accessories across Ontario?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We ship accessories anywhere in Ontario; shipping is quoted by phone based on your order and location. If you are buying a sauna from us, we can bring your accessories with your sauna delivery and set them up on installation day.

mainEntity.name: Can I see the accessories before I buy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Visit our showroom at 17380 Highway 27, Schomberg (King Township), ON L0G 1T0. Visits are by appointment; call (437) 429-6623 to book.
Unused accessories in their original packaging can be returned. Processing fees and shipping costs are deducted from your refund. Contact us before sending anything back so we can arrange the return.

mainEntity.name: Which heater control do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: HUUM electric heaters need a HUUM UKU control: choose Wi-Fi for app control or Local for an in-sauna panel only. Homecraft heaters run through a contactor and touchpad; pick the indoor or outdoor version to match where your sauna sits, and Wi-Fi if you want to start it from your phone.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a safety railing around my heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is not required, but we recommend one for families and for smaller saunas where knees and elbows are close to the heater. HUUM makes fitted railings for the Drop and HIVE Mini.

mainEntity.name: What accessories suit a barrel sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: A curved ceiling heat shield above the heater, a cedar backrest or two, a floor mat, and a bucket, ladle and thermometer. Wood-fired barrels pair well with a cedar firewood barrel or a Narvi wood basket.

mainEntity.name: Are LED lights safe inside a sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every light we carry is made for sauna heat and humidity. The SaunaScapes Sade RGB sets and the Kaiku sound system carry a 2-year warranty, and the Electric Sauna Light is marine-grade.

mainEntity.name: What is soapstone, and why use it?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dense Finnish stone that absorbs heat slowly and releases it gently, which makes it ideal for steam stones, aroma cups and thermometers.

mainEntity.name: How do I look after the cedar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Meldos sauna oil on interior cedar and Livos oil on the exterior. Left untreated, cedar weathers to a silver-grey that many owners love.

A simple start to the sauna ritual. Most owners add a backrest and a floor mat next.

items.name: Wooden Sauna Bucket & Ladle
items.desc: Handcrafted cedar with a plastic liner. Fill, ladle onto the stones, and make löyly.
long: The standard bucket and ladle set, made from cedar. In a cedar-lined sauna, it looks like it belongs there.
A plastic liner inside the bucket holds the water, so the wood stays sound. Fill it, ladle water onto the hot stones, and make löyly: the wave of steam at the heart of a Finnish sauna.

items.name: Narvi Black Bucket & Ladle
items.desc: Black aluminum with birch details. A modern Finnish take on the classic set.
long: Most sauna buckets are pale wood, and so are most saunas, so the bucket disappears. Narvi’s Black series does the opposite: a black aluminum bucket that stands out against a cedar bench.
The matching ladle pairs a black aluminum spoon with a birch handle. It’s the piece you actually hold, so the handle matters.

items.name: Comfort Sauna Backrest
items.desc: A convex shape with a slight arch that supports an upright, well-postured seat.
long: The Comfort backrest supports an upright seated posture. Its convex shape and slight arch encourage good posture and let your back rest gently against it.
Best if you like to sit up during your session. Prefer to lean back? See the Elite backrest.

items.name: Elite Sauna Backrest
items.desc: A concave curve that follows your spine and takes your weight, so you can lean back.

items.name: Standard Sauna Headrest
items.desc: Angled, ergonomic cedar headrest that supports your head and neck.
long: Lie back on a flat bench and your neck ends up doing all the work. This cedar headrest has an angled, ergonomic shape that cradles your head and neck, so you can stretch out and properly relax.

long: An egg-shaped soapstone cup that nestles among the heater stones. Add water and a few drops of essence; the dense stone warms slowly, so the scent lasts through your session.

items_2.name: SAUNAJOY Soapstone Massage Stone
items_2.desc: A palm-sized soapstone massage stone shaped to grip. Warm it in the sauna and work tight shoulders and back.
long: Finnish soapstone holds heat gently and evenly, so SAUNAJOY stays comfortably warm as you massage. The shaped grip fits your fingers for easy pressure on shoulders, back and legs.

items_2.name: MINI SOLEJOY Foot Massager with Cork Base
items_2.desc: A soapstone ball in a cork cradle. Roll your foot over it after a session to ease tired soles.
long: A smooth soapstone ball sits in a cork base so it stays put on the floor. Roll the arch of your foot over it to relax tired soles. Lovely after a long day or a long sauna.

items_2.name: SAUNATROIKKA Soapstone Fountain
items_2.desc: A soapstone cup filled with small stones that sits on the heater. Pour water in and it sends up a playful fountain of steam.
long: Set SAUNATROIKKA among the heater stones and pour water into it: the small stones inside heat up and send the water back up in a lively burst of steam. A favourite talking point in any sauna.

items_2.name: PISARAINEN Soapstone Thermometer (Celsius)
items_2.desc: The water-drop soapstone thermometer with a copper centre, reading 20–120 °C.
long: The Celsius version of PISARAINEN: a drop-shaped Finnish soapstone body with a cream dial reading 20 to 120 °C and a copper centre cap.

items_2.name: MAININKI Soapstone Thermometer & Hygrometer
items_2.desc: A carved soapstone piece with two copper-capped dials: temperature in °C and humidity in %.
long: MAININKI is carved from a single piece of Finnish soapstone and holds two dials side by side, one for temperature (°C) and one for humidity, so you can see exactly how your löyly is building.

items_2.name: GRANDPA Engraved Soapstone
items_2.desc: A soapstone block engraved with “GRANDPA”. The companion to GRANDMA.
long: A rough-edged soapstone block engraved with “GRANDPA”. Pair it with GRANDMA for a family keepsake in the sauna.

items_2.name: 4oz Eucalyptus Sauna Essence
items_2.desc: The classic steam scent: sharp and green rather than sweet. Mix a few drops into your bucket.

items_2.name: 4oz Lavender Sauna Essence
items_2.desc: Where eucalyptus wakes a room up, lavender settles it. A few drops in the bucket.

items_2.name: Nystad Sauna Scent: Birch Leaf (3-Pack)
items_2.desc: Ground Finnish birch leaves in biodegradable sachets that steep in your bucket like tea.

items_2.name: Nystad Sauna Scent: Birch & Peppermint (3-Pack)
items_2.desc: Peppermint reads as cold in a hot room, a crisp contrast to the heat.

items_2.name: Nystad Sauna Scent: Birch & Lavender (3-Pack)
items_2.desc: Lavender softens the birch rather than competing with it. Made for evening sessions.

items_2.name: Sauna Menthol (25g Bag)
items_2.desc: Crystals made from natural essential mint oil that bring a cool sensation to a hot room.

items_2.name: Aromatherapy Oil Cup
items_2.desc: Holds oil above the heat so the scent evaporates slowly instead of flashing off the stones.

items_2.name: Rento Foot Care Set
items_2.desc: A Finnish foot care set that turns your post-sauna routine into a soothing ritual.

items_2.name: 750ml Sauna Room Cleaner
items_2.desc: Spray-and-wipe cleaner made for the wood surfaces inside your sauna.

items_2.name: Narvi Black Thermometer (Celsius)
items_2.desc: Durable black aluminum face in a natural birch frame. Reads in Celsius.

items_2.name: Narvi Black Thermometer (Fahrenheit)
items_2.desc: The same black aluminum and birch thermometer, reading in Fahrenheit.

items_2.name: Narvi Black Sand Timer
items_2.desc: 15-minute timer in black steel with birch details. Time your rounds without a phone.

items_2.name: Cedar Sauna Thermometer
items_2.desc: Classic teardrop cedar shape with a dial that reads both temperature and humidity.

items_2.name: Wall Mount 15-Minute Sand Timer
items_2.desc: Heat- and moisture-tolerant cedar frame for a classic, rustic look on the wall.

blocks.html: HUUM electric heaters need a HUUM UKU control: choose Wi-Fi for app control or Local for an in-sauna panel only. Homecraft heaters run through a contactor and touchpad; pick the indoor or outdoor version to match where your sauna sits, and Wi-Fi if you want to start it from your phone.

blocks.html: Do I need a safety railing around my heater?

blocks.html: It is not required, but we recommend one for families and for smaller saunas where knees and elbows are close to the heater. HUUM makes fitted railings for the Drop and HIVE Mini.
